# class: Tracing
* since: v1.12

API for collecting and saving Playwright traces. Playwright traces can be opened in [Trace Viewer](../trace-viewer.md) after Playwright script runs.

:::note
You probably want to [enable tracing in your config file](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testoptions#test-options-trace) instead of using `context.tracing`.

The `context.tracing` API captures browser operations and network activity, but it doesn't record test assertions (like `expect` calls). We recommend [enabling tracing through Playwright Test configuration](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-testoptions#test-options-trace), which includes those assertions and provides a more complete trace for debugging test failures.
:::

practicalLimit.derivation: For equal observed p95 d, symmetric duration error epsilon and no sampling uncertainty, the upper box ratio is (d+epsilon)/(d-epsilon). Requiring this <=1.05 needs d>=41epsilon with positive denominator.
practicalLimit.implication: WebKit epsilon about1ms needs about41ms, incompatible with the <=10ms application-work target. Chromium epsilon about0.2ms needs about8.2ms, already above the0.6*B budget at90Hz and faster. Numerical allowance and sampling uncertainty make these limits stricter. This is an idealized sensitivity illustration, not a measured result or claim that every faster/favorable comparison is undecidable.
practicalLimit.decision: Do not promise that a correctly bound endpoint box will close practical overhead gates. The current empirical-only fence remains appropriate.

alternatives.name: Model-based reconstruction from rounded/grouped data
alternatives.assessment: Not recommended as a qualification shortcut. Grouped-data quantile estimators can interpolate or fit an underlying density, but that adds assumptions about sub-bucket distribution and censoring. Ordinary frames include mixed mechanisms and correlated timing. More rounded samples alone do not identify an unrestricted latent per-frame p95 tightly enough; smoothness or dither assumptions need external validation, not a favorable fitted curve.

alternatives.name: Exact native-clock boundary records
alternatives.assessment: Most plausible Chromium feasibility path. At the existing PRE_STEP and POST_RENDER work boundaries, fixed-label console.timeStamp records native trace timestamps rather than recycling performance.now values. Preserve the exact per-frame work interval and compute the same per-run p95 from complete retained pairs. Default performance.mark also has a separate raw Chromium trace timestamp, but creates buffered entries and tracing work, so it is not a free high-resolution replacement.

alternatives.name: WebKit native Timeline
alternatives.assessment: The native inspector uses an execution stopwatch, but TimeStamp records capture call stacks and create JSON. Passing stack depth0 falls back to5 in the pinned source. Public pinned Playwright CDP and browser-native tracing dispatchers reject non-Chromium browsers; context.tracing is an automation trace. A supported collection path and its observer behavior are still unresolved. Do not imply a simple existing WebKit adapter or introduce a private driver/browser patch silently.

alternatives.name: Totals, amplification, isolation or different conditions
alternatives.assessment: Block averages, repeated synthetic work, CPU slowdown, process CPU totals, raised clock precision or altered cross-origin isolation do not silently replace normal per-frame p95. They may diagnose or calibrate but change the estimand or conditions. No such substitution is proposed.

candidateFeasibilityPilot.scope: Only after the original trace-v2 outcome and explicit protocol review. This is a bounded validation experiment, not prospective acceptance, and has not been implemented or dispatched.
fixedFactors: Same final-source package and browser binaries, viewport, cadence setting, input/replay recipe, phases, audio/profile data and CPU conditions as the declared overhead comparison.
Same diagnostics on/off matched arms and original5% target. No favorable frame deletion, no screenshots, allocation sampling or CPU profiler in the native boundary cohort.

Two fixed-label boundary events, monotonic sequence matching and complete event pairing; bounded bytes/records and confirmed process closure before parsing. Overflow, missing pairs, lost trace data, ambiguous frame ownership or incomplete workloads remain failed/unresolved.
observerValidation: First establish that native boundaries correspond to the exact existing work envelope; a whole RAF or task duration cannot replace it merely because it is easier to capture.
Use A/A controls with identical diagnostic modes and the same balanced order to detect an analyst/probe-induced apparent effect.

Measure empty probe pairs for direct recording cost, then test probe-density and trace-category sensitivity on the actual workload. Empty probes alone cannot capture GC, cache, allocation or buffer saturation effects.

Compare ordinary untraced cadence/work distributions with trace-only and trace-plus-boundary runs; use native whole-callback timings and process totals only as supplementary observer checks. No detected difference at a coarse resolution is not proof of zero effect.

Retain observer effects separately for diagnostics off and on; do not assume equal recording cost cancels or subtract one probe p95 from an application p95. Material interactions, nonlinearity or an observer uncertainty large enough to change the5% decision make the result unresolved.
candidateFeasibilityPilot.estimator: Use the same matched run-level statistic based on complete per-frame work durations. Retain all pairs and order information. Carry native clock/conversion uncertainty and a separately justified observer-effect uncertainty through the upper confidence/sensitivity result. A new model or resampling method must state its dependence and tail assumptions; individual frames are not independent experimental replications.
candidateFeasibilityPilot.acceptanceBoundary: A traced result is initially evidence for the declared traced measurement setup. It cannot clear the ordinary diagnostics-overhead gate until the reviewed calibration supports transfer to that target with quantified limitations. If that transfer is not defensible, retain a scoped estimate and unresolved gate rather than changing the5% target.
candidateFeasibilityPilot.stopRule: If a supported collection path, correct endpoint identity or sufficiently small observer uncertainty cannot be demonstrated in a bounded pilot, stop expanding tooling and report the overhead exit unresolved. Continue unrelated gameplay/release qualification.

primaryMethodReferences.application: Grouped quantile confidence intervals use density approximation/interpolation assumptions; they are not automatic recovery of arbitrary sub-bin timing.
Interval-valued observations can partially identify quantiles; identification uncertainty is distinct from finite-sample confidence.
Measurement overhead can vary with event volume, cache effects and saturation, so null calibration alone need not predict actual workload effects; stateful runs require care with independence.
Chrome distinguishes console.timeStamp from buffered User Timing entries and describes the former as a low-overhead tracing mechanism; this is not a measured cost bound for this app.
Native trace timestamp domains and event categories can be controlled, while record production and argument work remain part of the observer.

limits: No binary execution was performed. Native event collection/support, practical cost, completeness and quantitative acceptance have not been established.
Current trace-v2 remains an excluded diagnostic and does not acquire acceptance by this research.
No general guarantee about iPhone Safari, browser scheduling, device thermal behavior or all uninstrumented executions is claimed.
